scope: QVF voting history, not tabulator results. Source-native totals can exclude unavailable Election Day data; absentee returned does not mean accepted/tabulated. Three numeric modes do not establish finished clerk uploads, counting or certification. Printed active-registration percentages are preserved, never inverted into denominators or presented as CVAP/VAP/VEP/generic registration turnout. Unavailable or suppressed cells stay missing; no residual reconstruction. Permanent vote-by-mail enrollment is not participation. No candidate/party totals or demographic turnout are supplied. Native timezone and FIPS are absent.
